sloka: जीवित अन्तकरैः घोरैः ज्वलद्भिः इव पन्नगैः ।महा प्रमाणौ विपुलौ तप्त हाटक भूषणौ ॥४-३-१८॥
transliteration: jīvita antakaraiḥ ghoraiḥ jvaladbhiḥ iva pannagaiḥ ।mahā pramāṇau vipulau tapta hāṭaka bhūṣaṇau ॥4-3-18॥

translations.english: '(Your) long and broad swords appear very huge in size. Being encrusted with pure gold, they glitter brilliant like snakes in hyberation.
